question: Does the bounded tri-evidence proposal set cover target door 4 in all three query views of the preselected fifth family?

contributors: highest layer18_local_appearance_score minus 0.05 times minimum absolute log-area deviation to any of the three reference target boxes
hypothesis_generation.deduplication: Merge contributors only when tile_id, postprocess_index and exact box coordinates are identical.
hypothesis_generation.tie_break: Higher layer-18 local, target-memory and objectness scores, then lexicographic box and postprocess index.

literature_motivation.use: Retain multiple object interpretations under ambiguity and resolve them with later evidence or action.
Model multiple structured instance-mask hypotheses for recall.

forbidden_after_freeze: change any contributor, score, 0.05 penalty, tie break, deduplication, maximum set size or IoU gate
use query truth, sibling appearance or controls in hypothesis generation
add a fourth hypothesis, rescue a failed query or reinterpret proposal coverage as top-one localization
claim_boundary: A pass confirms only bounded proposal recall on one wholly new fifth 3RScan family under provider truth and a maximum set size of three. It does not confirm top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty, open-set rejection, instance ownership, referent identity, named entrance, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability or safety.
